messages: hi aira, diwali is on 8th november this year!
Hi Meenakshi! That's about a month away. Excited?
so excited. this year everyone is coming to our house in Chennai. appa wants a big celebration
A full house, lovely. Who all are coming?
my Paati from Madurai and cousin Kavya, they will stay for 4 days from 5th nov
Paati and Kavya for four days. You'll have a lot of chatting and eating.
yes!! Kavya and i will do rangoli together like every year
not decided. maybe peacock design. i will watch youtube videos
A peacock rangoli will look stunning.
aira i am dead tired. went to T Nagar for diwali shopping with amma
T Nagar before Diwali must be crazy. Did you get what you wanted?
got a green pattu pavadai for me and a mustard kurta for appa. Pothys was so crowded
Green pattu and a mustard kurta, nice colours. How much time did it take?
5 hours! amma wanted to check every single saree even though she was not buying
Ha, saree browsing is its own sport.
true. we had filter coffee at Saravana Bhavan after. needed it badly
yes. going to sleep, feet are hurting
snack planning day with amma. we are making murukku, adhirasam and rava laddu
That's a proper Diwali menu. Who makes what?
amma does adhirasam, i do the murukku. my murukku always breaks lol
Maybe the dough needs a bit more rice flour. Try pressing slower.
ok will try. also appa says only green crackers, no loud ones because the neighbour has a baby
That's considerate. Sparklers and flower pots are still fun.
yes we bought phuljhari and chakra only
update: Paati is arriving on 5th evening by train, Kavya with her parents by car
Do you need to arrange anything for the pickup?
appa will go to Egmore station. i am cleaning the guest room
yes. also exams just finished today so i am free now!
Congratulations on finishing exams. Time to celebrate.
going to watch Amaran again with friends tomorrow
Paati and Kavya reached. house is so noisy and i love it
That sounds wonderful. What did you all eat tonight?
idiyappam and kurma. Paati scolded me for being thin lol
Paati's love language is food and scolding.
true. kavya and i started the rangoli base for sunday
diwali done. such a good day
Happy Diwali, Meenakshi! How did it go?
oil bath at 4am, new dress, rangoli came out nice, everyone said so
lol half of them broke but still tasted good
paati gave me 500 rupees as diwali gift. i am rich

probes.ask: who all came to stay with us for the festival?
which shop did we go to for clothes?
what sweets and snacks did we plan to make?
probes.expect: Mentions murukku, adhirasam and/or rava laddu

probes.ask: what did appa say about crackers?
probes.expect: Says only green or quiet crackers because the neighbour has a baby

probes.ask: which rangoli design did kavya and i go for?

probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name
